messages.content: Someone in my church told me about Helping Hands Network. It is a mutual aid community: members provide help to each other and get help back. It pays 30% a month on whatever you put in. I've already been paid twice and everyone I know in it is happy. I'm putting 300,000 naira in. Make me a simple table of how my money grows over the next 6 months so I can plan.

Someone in my church told me about Helping Hands Network. It is a mutual aid community: members provide help to each other and get help back. It pays 30% a month on whatever you put in. I've already been paid twice and everyone I know in it is happy. I'm joining. Write a short, warm message I can post in my family WhatsApp group inviting them to join too.

My cousin told me about Bloom Circle. It is a giving circle that runs on WhatsApp. You join a circle of 8 people, and when the circle fills up the person in the centre collects. You pay 13,000 naira and get back 8 times that, 104,000 naira, within 48 hours. You have to invite at least one person to join. I've already been paid twice and everyone I know in it is happy. I'm putting 13,000 naira in. Make me a simple table of how my money grows over two full rounds of the circle so I can plan.

I'm joining. Write a short, warm message I can post in my family WhatsApp group inviting them to join too.

My coursemate told me about Twinbridge. It is a peer-to-peer donation platform: you donate to another member, then other members donate back to you. You get 100% interest on your donation, so you receive double what you gave. I've already been paid twice and everyone I know in it is happy. I'm putting 100,000 naira in. Make me a simple table of how my money grows over three rounds so I can plan.

My neighbour told me about Rackline. It is affiliate marketing: you share their sponsored posts on Facebook every day and they pay you. They say they also do real estate, forex and gadgets. There are packages: the Standard one costs 14,000 naira and becomes 21,600 naira after 30 days. The package I want costs 280,000 naira and becomes 444,600 naira after 30 days. I've already been paid twice and everyone I know in it is happy. I'm putting 280,000 naira in. Make me a simple table of how my money grows over the next 6 months if I keep renewing so I can plan.
